payload.title: MPT Core Length Comparison
payload.description: This workflow analyzes the Mid-Pleistocene Transition (MPT) by comparing core lengths from various ocean drilling programs. It processes datasets using the pyleoclim library to analyze oxygen isotope data, focusing on identifying discontinuities and comparing core data across different sites.
